name: AI Contract Intelligence System: Clause Detection and LLM-Based Rewriting
description:
Built an end-to-end Legal AI application that analyzes PDF, DOCX, and TXT contracts, extracts individual clauses, and classifies them into 41 legal provision categories using a LoRA-adapted LegalBERT model trained on the CUAD dataset. The system applies rule-based risk filtering to identify potentially unfavorable clauses, including uncapped liability and immediate termination provisions.


Integrated a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline using Sentence Transformers and FAISS to retrieve similar legal clauses and generate clearer, more balanced rewrites through LLaMA 3. Developed a FastAPI backend and interactive Streamlit dashboard for contract upload, clause-level analysis, risk visualization, and rewrite recommendations.

Key result: Improved clause-classification accuracy from 1.9% to 69.8%, achieving a Macro F1 score of 0.650 across 41 clause categories.
